name: Rentista (Passive Income) Permanent Residence

requirements.blocker_text: IGM's Rentista category requires USD 1,250/month in permanent foreign-source income (pensions, retirement funds, rental income, or investment dividends), plus USD 300/month per dependent. Unusually, this grants PERMANENT residence immediately on approval (a one-time USD 400 fee, no annual renewals) rather than a temporary status that upgrades later -- income must be re-verified every 5 years. After 5 years as a domiciled foreigner, the applicant becomes eligible to apply for citizenship.
requirements.fix_path: Document USD 1,250/month in qualifying permanent foreign income (plus USD 300/month per dependent), and apply to IGM.

evidence_required.document: Proof of permanent foreign income (pension/rental/investment statements)

outcome.duration_length: indefinite (permanent residence on approval), income re-verified every 5 years

sources.title: Living in Guatemala (private expat-guide site) -- Rentista visa's USD 1,250/month threshold, immediate permanent-residence grant, 5-year income re-verification, and citizenship eligibility timeline

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Guatemala). STATUS: DRAFT -- sourced to a single tier-4 private expat-guide site; IGM's own government page/regulation for this specific category was not successfully fetched (403 errors on direct attempts). MODELING NOTE: Rentista is a PASSIVE-INCOME route (pensions, rent, dividends), not an active-investment/business-equity route -- it is modeled under the 'business' category as the closest available bucket in this dataset's schema (consistent with how other countries' passive-income/investor residency routes have been categorized), not because it requires running or owning a Guatemalan business. GENUINELY DISTINCTIVE FINDING: granting PERMANENT (not temporary-then-upgradeable) residence immediately on approval, for a comparatively modest USD 1,250/month threshold, is more generous than most investor/passive-income routes built in this dataset -- most require years of temporary status first. work_rights set 'none' since Rentista status is explicitly passive-income-based, not employment-authorizing. family_can_work left null since the source did not address dependents' independent work rights.
